run_bench_tuple_unpacking: run the tuple unpacking microbenchmark with a specified number of loops
run_bench_list_unpacking: run the list unpacking microbenchmark with a specified number of loops
run_bench_all: run both tuple and list unpacking benchmarks and return combined elapsed time
run_s6_bench_all: run the unpacking benchmark with S6 JIT compilation for performance comparison
run_s6_bench_with_cli: run the unpack sequence benchmark from the command line with optional iteration count argument
